lines.trans: I learned a lesson. I am grateful to Ivan Vasilyevich for his honest opinion.
So you admit that you took bribes?
No, I didn't take bribes. But I thought too little about people.
I got into trouble. And I understood how hard life is for the people.

words.gloss: trouble, misfortune (попасть в беду = get into trouble)

lines.trans: Ivan Vasilyevich, is throwing a person out the window normal?
And what are we supposed to do with them? They've completely lost their conscience!
And what do you propose? Throwing all officials out the window?
Could do all of them! Only that won't help.
Right, that won't help! People need to do it themselves now.
Do what themselves?
Go into government themselves? What does that mean?

words.gram: preposition + accusative (form of в before вл-)

lines.trans: Ivan Vasilyevich is moving from words to action.
He is putting forward his candidacy for the post of mayor of the city!
Do you confirm this, Ivan Vasilyevich?
Yes, yes! I am putting forward my candidacy.
Samsonov has the main thing — honesty and decency. Everyone talks, while he gets things done!
